scripts.build: dotnet build Mohist.sln -p:SkipWebBuild=true && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: dotnet test Mohist.sln -p:SkipWebBuild=true && npm run test:ci --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:fast: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n typecheck,unit,arch,wf,cli,web,runner -c blue,yellow,cyan,magenta,green,red,white "npm run typecheck:fast" "npm run test:fast:unit" "npm run test:fast:arch" "npm run test:fast:wf" "npm run test:fast:cli" "npm run test:run -w packages/web" "npm test -w packages/runner"
scripts.typecheck:fast: npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck -w packages/web && npm run typecheck -w packages/runner
scripts.verify: npm run docs:check && npm run check:filesizes && npm run build && npm test
scripts.archtest: npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run test:archscripts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:cli: dotnet pack packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/Mohist.Cli.csproj -c Release -o ./nupkg && dotnet tool install -g Mohist.Cli --add-source ./nupkg
